name: cut green oak log
description: a cut, green log with light gray, scaly bark
details: A thick section of oak trunk, cut square at both ends, with light gray bark broken into scaly plates by shallow fissures.  The cut ends show tight growth rings of light brown heartwood ringed by paler, nearly white sapwood.  The wood is still green and heavy with sap, and the inner bark shows reddish-orange where it has been scraped away.
keywords: cut green oak log cut log green log light gray scaly bark growth rings light brown heartwood white sapwood green wood
